title: Quasi-coherent derived categories have direct sums
statement: For every scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme], the full subcategory $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] of $D(\mathcal O_X)$ on complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology has all set-indexed direct sums.
